title: Add configurable account lockout threshold
description: Authentication must lock an account after a configurable number of failed sign-in attempts. Reset behavior requires product confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given an active account, when failed sign-ins reach the configured threshold, then the account is locked.
The default threshold is five attempts.
Successful sign-in resets the failed-attempt counter.
non_functional_requirements: Do not expose credentials or personal data in logs.
Existing authentication tests must continue to pass.
